identity.description: Vercel: frontend cloud platform for hosting and deploying web apps (Next.js and others) with a public REST API, official TypeScript SDK, and official remote MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: Vercel docs describe the REST API as the account interface and the product is the Vercel platform (vercel.com). Confirmed by vercel.com docs pages; the 'vercel' GitHub owner hosts the SDK and MCP repos.

auth.oauth_flows: Vercel MCP uses OAuth for client authorization (remote MCP at mcp.vercel.com). REST API OAuth2 app flow not verified from fetched pages; an example response shows token type 'oauth2-token' and an SSO token exchange endpoint exists.
auth.scopes_notes: Created tokens carry a 'scopes' array; a token can be scoped to a single project via projectId at creation. Team context is passed via teamId or slug query parameters.

access.production_restrictions: Vercel MCP: clients must use Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) or be reviewed and approved by Vercel to be supported. This applies to MCP client builders, not REST token creation. No partner/sales gate found for REST tokens in fetched pages, but plan gating for token creation was not established.

resources: Environment variables (referenced in CLI/docs search only)
api.limitations: Only partially verified: fetched REST overview was truncated, so the full endpoint list is not confirmed. Webhook management endpoints (GET /v1/webhooks) appear in search snippets only. Rate limits not found.
